subject: Kickoff: soft-attribute semantics for recommender search
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the attribute-semantics workstream today. Goal: turn our open-source CAV work on personalized soft attributes into a queryable layer for the recommendations product, so users can ask for "less violent" or "funnier" and actually get it.

Scope for this half: reproduce the MovieLens 20M pipeline (lowercased tags, ratings >= 4 filter, 0.75/0.25 train-test split), then validate the learned concept activation vectors against the SoftAttributes dataset before we touch production embeddings.

Rough milestones: pipeline reproduction by early April, offline eval readout mid-May, launch review submission before the Q3 OKR lock on 6/26. Jelena owns staffing; Katya and Yara on modeling, Maren on the serving path.

Thoughts on the milestones by Friday please.

Anders
